title: Mining Together
description: MiningTogether makes block breaking in multiplayer shared and faster, with mining progress that doesn’t reset immediately and slowly regenerates over time.
body:
**MiningTogether** improves multiplayer mining by making block breaking a shared and cooperative process. Instead of each player mining separately, progress is combined between all players, allowing blocks to break faster when working together.

Mining progress no longer resets instantly when you stop mining a block. Instead, it is preserved for a short period, letting players continue exactly where they left off. After this delay, the progress slowly regenerates back to zero over time.

This creates a smoother and more natural mining experience, especially in multiplayer, where teamwork directly affects how quickly blocks are broken.
